_about: The forecast's inputs. Both the Model page (model/model.js) and code/strike_probabilities.py read this file; edit here only. Dollar amounts are $ billions at a seasonally adjusted annual rate.

CHANGE.note: change carried forward from September; default is the last first-print change (September first print minus August first print)

ADJUST.note: adjustment for the current state; not yet set

SPREAD.note: standard deviation: 6.19% (last 24 months of misses) x $108.0B

SKEW.note: skewness of the last 24 months of misses

KURT.note: kurtosis of the last 24 months of misses

shape_window.note: base case for standard deviation, skewness and kurtosis: the base rate's misses on Census's current figures over the last 24 months, standard deviation scaled to the October base rate
